THE_QGOV_NETWORK_IS: The QGOV network is stabilized by sophisticated economics that distribute token rewards through different pools and proxies to the according reward earner.
IN_ORDER_TO_SLASH: In order to slash the same validator again, root node needs to purge all his slashing transactions.
LOCK_THE_NUMBER_OF_TOKENS: Lock the number of tokens that you plan to vote with (the number of locked tokens will set your voting weight).
BORROWING_VAULT_IS: Borrowing vault is free for liquidation due to price fluctuation of collateralized assets.
SYSTEM_DEPT_OVERPASSES: System dept overpasses the threshold and netting is not possible.
SYSTEM_SURPLUS_OVERPASSES: System surplus overpasses the threshold and netting is not possible.
BLOCKCHAIN_IS: Blockchain is a growing list of records, called blocks, that are securely linked together using cryptography.
ROOT_NODES_ARE: Root nodes are the guardians of the QGOV constitution. They watch over all system participants but especially over validators.
QGOV_IS: QGOV is based on a legal contract that everyone participating in QGOV agrees upon: the constitution. It includes rules and responsibilities of all parties.
VALIDATORS_ARE: Validators are validating transactions and "mining" blocks through a delegated proof-of-stake consensus algorithm (dPoS).
QGOV_GOVERNANCE_IS: QGOV governance is enforced through proposals that can be voted for or against. Each proposal type has a different life cycle and stages differ depending on the proposal initiator.
THIS_LIST_SHOWS_ALL_CURRENT_EXPERTS: This list shows all current experts that take over administration of QGOV DeFi system parameters.
THIS_LIST_SHOWS_ALL_CURRENT_EXPERTS_THAT: This list shows all current experts that take over administration of QGOV system parameters around fees & incentives.
THE_QGOV_BORROWING_MARKET_ALLOWS: The QGOV Borrowing market allows users to borrow QUSD against tokenized collateral. The borrowed assets can then be used for payments or saved to earn interest.
VALIDATORS_ARE_ELECTED: Validators are eligible to operate as Validator based on QGOV their holdings they put at stake. Validators publish new blocks in a rotation system which reduces communication among validators.
ROOT_NODES_MONITOR_VALIDATOR_NODES: Root Nodes monitor Validator Nodes to ensure that they comply with the QGOV Constitution. The Root Node layer enables the effective enforcement of the QGOV Constitution that cannot be enforced on a purely technical basis.
QGOV_VAULT_IS_SINGLE_SPACE: QGOV Vault is single space to lock {{asset}} tokens and accrue claimable reward on both pools simultaneously.
YOU_CAN_DELEGATE_THE_VOTING_POWER: You can delegate the voting power of your {{asset}} token that are located within QGOV vault to other wallet addresses. This is useful to concentrate voting weight spread over multiple addresses to a single wallet, reducing time effort and transaction cost for participating in QGOV token holder votings.
VALIDATOR_RECEIVE_THEIR_REWARD_BASED: Validators receive their reward based on the stake they have put onto their validator nodes address. By delegating Q, any QGOV token holder can increase a validator nodes stake and, if the validator manages correctly his staker reward pool, earn a defined share of validation reward.
QGOV_TOKENS_CAN_BE_TIME_LOCKED: {{asset}} tokens can be time locked (vested) for a certain period of time. Depending on the time lock type, these funds can be used for staking or QGOV token holder reward earning. All vested tokens are elegible for token holder votings.

DEFAULT_ALLOCATION_PROXY_TOOLTIP:
Default allocation proxy serves and allocates all rewards in the QGOV ecosystem. The rewards come from the following sources:
- The {{asset}} token inflation (block subsidy)
- The slashed tokens of successful slashing proposals
- Revenue from the Saving & Borrowing
- Future plans for DAO payment for "Governance-as-a-Service"
VALIDATION_REWARD_PROXY_TOOLTIP: Validation Reward Proxy allocates rewards to validators and their pools. The number of validators eligible for rewards is determined by sum of two constitutional parameters ("maxNValidators" + "maxNStandbyValidators").
ROOT_NODE_REWARD_PROXY_TOOLTIP: Root Node Reward Proxy allocates rewards to root nodes. Every member of the root node panel earns the same rewards, irrespective of their stake.
AUCTIONS_TOOLTIP:
Decentralized auctions are the vehicle to maintain the DeFi system's stability. There are three different types of auctions:
- Liquidation: for borrowing vault liquidation auctions
- System Debt: If DeFi system significantly lacks of synthetic asset (e.g. QUSD), any user can bid in QUSD to receive a lot of {{asset}} tokens
- System Surplus: If DeFi system significantly created a surplus in synthetic asset (e.g. QUSD), these tokens can be purchased by bidding {{asset}} tokens to receive a certain lot size of synthetic asset
DEBT_AUCTION_LOT_TOOLTIP: Debt Auction Lot defines the number of {{asset}} tokens the winner of a system debt auction will receive.
SURPLUS_AUCTION_LOT_TOOLTIP: Surplus Auction Lot defines the number of stablecoins the winner of a system surplus auction will receive.
SYSTEM_BALANCE_TOOLTIP: System Balance shows different balances of DeFi application, like collected surplus and open debt as well as actual balance in stablecoin and the surplus auction lot size as per system parameter. A click on "Perform Netting" will net out surplus with open debt without initiating an auction.
SYSTEM_RESERVE_TOOLTIP: QGOV Token Holders have a special interest and responsibility for the overall system stability. Part of their reward is transferred to the QGOV System Reserve which is serves as final bastion for systemic emergencies.
RESERVE_BALANCE_TOOLTIP: "Reserve Balance" shows the total reserved balance.
RESERVE_AVAILABLE_TOOLTIP: To limit the risk of the QGOV System Reserve draining empty too quickly the reserve amount to withdraw is limited to the "Immediately Available" amount (defined by "governed.EPQFI.reserveCoolDownThreshold" parameter). This amount can be refreshed when the cool-down period is over.
RESERVE_STATE_TOOLTIP: When the reserve state is paused, the funds are not available for withdrawal. Only root nodes and EPQFI experts can pause the reserve system.
RESERVE_COOL_DOWN_TOOLTIP: "Cool-down End Time" defines when the "Immediately Available" amount can be refreshed. This refresh happens on every new withdrawal request if the current cool-down end time has passed. The cool-down period before the new refresh is defined as "governed.EPQFI.reserveCoolDownP" parameter.
